column1: fever,Viral Infection,Drink fluids, rest, take paracetamol
cough,Respiratory Infection,Drink warm liquids, take cough syrup
headache,Stress or Migraine,Take pain reliever, avoid screen time
chest pain,Possible Heart Issue,Seek immediate medical attention
stomach pain,Indigestion or Ulcer,Drink warm water, avoid spicy food
shortness of breath,Asthma or Anxiety,Use inhaler if prescribed, stay calm
joint pain,Arthritis or Injury,Apply ice/heat, take anti-inflammatory meds
high blood sugar,Diabetes,Take insulin if prescribed, limit sugar intake
low blood pressure,Hypotension,Drink more fluids, eat salty foods
high blood pressure,Hypertension,Reduce salt, exercise, take prescribed meds
skin rash,Allergic Reaction,Apply anti-allergy cream, take antihistamines
weakness,Anemia or Fatigue,Take iron supplements, get enough sleep
vision problems,Possible Eye Strain,Reduce screen time, wear protective glasses
